description: This file contains localization strings, configuration-dependent prompts, and UI text for the NextChat application, specifically for the English language version. It defines various UI labels, prompts, and dynamic message functions used throughout the app.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Generates input hint text indicating the submit key, and additional instructions based on the submit key.

methods.name: Overview
methods.description: Creates a summary string of chat statistics, including counts of chats, messages, prompts, and masks.

methods.name: SubTitle
methods.description: A function for dynamic subtitle generation, e.g., 'N messages'.
